name: work-plan-action-store
goal: Expose selected-project feature plan selection and approval to app controls without leaking results across project or bridge changes.

evidence: Expose digest-bound local bridge actions to a later review UI; keep mutations and late replies scoped to the selected project and bridge, with no provider launch.

Added a nonvisual action store that checks the visible digest and selected project, forwards only allowed bridge fields, and scopes pending and errors to observed project, bridge and capability changes.
Nineteen focused store cases passed, including the real Work snapshot boundary, late replies, duplicate actions, unavailable capability and attempts to override the selected project. No provider ran.
